# Viridis MCP

> Aristotle-verified attribution-enforcement services for AI agents. Three live tools at mcp.viridis-security.com: adversarial injection detection (T-IB-02), VulnCanon source scanning (T-IB-05), and Maxwell adaptive proof-of-work defense (T-IB-09). Free tier with 1,000 detect calls + 10 canon scans per month, no credit card. 7/7 corpus theorems formally proven in Lean 4 by Aristotle (Harmonic).

## Security Preflight

- [Product](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight): Static checks of caller-supplied MCP manifests, schemas, authority policy, and sample text. Signed, input-redacted assessment receipts. Does not fetch, execute, or certify the runtime.
- [Integration guide](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight/quickstart)
- [Complete buyer workflow](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-agent-fleet/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_PREFLIGHT_BUYER_QUICKSTART.md): Dedicated quote-first client, explicit capped purchase, private result retention, and caller-owned release change checks. No automatic payments.
- [Machine-readable service contract](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight/service.json)
- [Preflight OpenAPI](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight/openapi.json)
- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight/mcp
- Paid assessment: POST https://mcp.viridis-security.com/x402/security-preflight/security_preflight with caller-owned inputs. Inspect the unpaid HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header first. $1 USDC list price; an eligible introductory quote may be $0.01. Fresh quote and buyer mandate govern every payment.
- Free stateless change check: POST https://mcp.viridis-security.com/security-preflight/watch. Reuse an authentic current assessment only when the supplied artifacts are unchanged; preserve existing findings. This is not a managed subscription.
- Existing Injection Detector MCP remains at /mcp. Its API-key plans are separate from Preflight x402 payments.

## Services

- [Injection detection](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/v1/injection/detect): Classify untrusted text as clean / suspicious / attack with verdict + probability + bits-at-risk (Adversarial Landauer)
- [Canon scanner](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/v1/canon/scan): Match source code against the public VulnCanon catalog of AI-agent vulnerability classes
- [Maxwell challenge](https://mcp.viridis-security.com/v1/maxwell/challenge): Adaptive proof-of-work defense; defender pays log2(1/alpha)× attacker per bit (Growth+ tier)
